comparison_to_prior_synthetic_calibratio.interpretation: Both paths prove successful RV1126-targeted quantized conversion. The real-video proxy provides input statistics derived from real image content and a full-range phase feature. Different export size/hash is recorded but is not treated as proof of quality improvement or deterministic calibration impact because RKNN export-byte determinism has not been established.
